reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The provision of a sovereign loan of up to €61.7 million to the Kyrgyz Republic, to be on-lent to Open Joint Stock Company National Electric Grid of Kyrgyz Republic (NEGK) to finance the construction of (i) a new substation outside Balykchy city in the Issyk-Kul region (Balykchy SS) and (ii) a 500 kV overhead transmission line between the existing Kemin substation in the Chui region and the new Balykchy SS. The primary objective of the project is to support the connection of around 500 MW of planned renewable energy capacity under the development to the national power grid. Implementing the project will also significantly improve the transmission network's reliability, efficiency, stability, quality and security of the electricity supply.
